_readme: Read once at startup by frc.lib.swervetune. Every value below means 'leave YAGSL exactly as it is', except 'motors': the motor guard watches every motor for heat, stalls and failure, holds current limits to the team policy (NEO 550 20 A, NEO V1.1 60 A, NEO 2.0 80 A, Vortex 80 A), and steps in before one burns out. Name what each motor really is there, e.g. "drive": "NEO 2.0". The laptop tool (tools/swervetune) writes measured values here when you press Save; see docs/SWERVE_TUNING_GUIDE.md before editing by hand.
